description: Bounded text excerpts from real, public official filings, used as offline fixtures for the EDINET/OpenDART evidence-only document stages. Excerpts were retrieved on 2026-07-18 from the official public viewers (EDINET keyless PDF download host disclosure2dl.edinet-fsa.go.jp; DART public report viewer dart.fss.or.kr/report/viewer.do). '[…]' marks an elision between two excerpts of the same document; no text was reordered or altered beyond whitespace collapsing and markup stripping. These excerpts substantiate detector behaviour only; none of them is a tracker event.
